svg.text: OpenPocket v0 — wiring (modules, point-to-point, 30 AWG silicone wire)
All logic is 3.3 V. microSD over SPI. Battery pads are on the UNDERSIDE of the XIAO. Haptic motor and VBAT sense are optional.
A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected. ⏚ = short wire to GND (XIAO GND pad or the nearest GND splice).
Underside pads: BAT+ away from USB, BAT− nearest USB
SEL bridged to GND on the board = LEFT
SEL bridged to 3V on the board = RIGHT
Shared I2S bus: each mic drives DOUT only
in its WS half, high-Z otherwise.
DAT1 = socket pin 8, DAT2 = socket pin 1 (no header pin). CD unused.
pull-up (RTC), active LOW; wakes from deep sleep (ext0)
Motor+ and D1 cathode to BAT+, not 3V3.
Emitter returns on its own GND wire to the XIAO.
10 kΩ B–E keeps Q1 off while the ESP32 boots.
0–2.1 V on D0: ADC 12 dB attenuation + calibration.
LiPo 403040, 3.7 V 500 mAh, 4 mm, with PCM
Charged by the XIAO (100 mA, ~5 h). Solder one lead at a time;
tape the other. Cover pads with Kapton after soldering.
BAT+ also feeds the motor and the VBAT divider (dashed).
2.4 GHz FPC antenna (supplied with the XIAO)
U.FL onto the XIAO; stick the antenna under the RF window insert,
centred at (−31.5, −5.5), long side along Y. Never under solid metal.
Pin map (XIAO ESP32S3, all 11 GPIO used)
I2S BCLK (both mics), 33 Ω at the pin
I2S DOUT (both mics), 100 kΩ to GND
Button to GND, pull-up, deep-sleep wake
